properties.name: A member store refuses an approver its hub already knows, because a Contributor lives in one store and nothing in a family shares who is who
properties.statement:
Field log entry 2026-10-09 (hxm_program hub, VS Code 1.140, reflow2 0.80.0): add_decision status accepted with approver who:ajs was refused in a member store (cs-studio-xf). The hub holds who:ajs; add_contributor of the same id into the member was needed first.

MEASURED 2026-10-09 on 0.80.0 and main, same text: "no Contributor `who:ajs` in this design, so nothing was written. An approver who does not exist would attach the owner's authority to a name nobody can check. Create them with add_contributor first, or check the id." A fresh store holds no Contributor, and nothing copies one from a design that pins it, or that it pins.

It is a gap in the one-graph umbrella, not a defect in the refusal: identity is per store by design, and authority is only as checkable as the store it names (dec:idea-authentication-is-somebody-elses-layer-and-the-line-is-the-contributor-id). Each member a person writes to therefore costs one add_contributor, discovered by a refusal. Measured once by the reporter; how many member writes it cost over all their members is not measured.
